readings.source_reading: Rudrajāpya, mantras from VS, in viii adhy., ff.1-95, S.1923. I.O. 4521 (beginning differs)
readings.evidence: A single ink line at about y 2790–2870. There is nothing in the shelfmark column to its left and no tick. On fol. 228, in the left margin near c.20/d.144, there is 'See Rudrajāpyabhāṣya'. That note lies to the right of the fol. 227b page edge, so it belongs to fol. 228. Nothing physically links it to this line. The vertical positions do not match: this line is at the middle of the page, and the fol. 228 note is near the bottom.

readings.source_reading: A pencil oblique stroke runs from about (2790,3690) down to (2755,3855). It passes between '21½' and ':9/12:D.' and continues below the d.135(4) line, ending near 'Two recensions of same work.'
readings.evidence: The stroke does not run along the figures, so it does not look like a strike-through. It falls between two groups of figures and extends downward. Its function as cancellation, separator or marker cannot be determined.

readings.source_reading: '?' in pencil at about (2905,830). 'ī/' over 'ā/' in pencil at about (2925–3050, 1530–1820), each followed by a long oblique pencil stroke.
readings.evidence: In the fol. 228 overview, the 'ī/ ā/' and '?' appear to the left of the fol. 228 page edge. They are therefore this page's own marks, captured in the adjacent photograph, not separate marks on fol. 228. A similar 'a/ ā/' pair appears in the left margin of the fol. 227 image, which shows the facing page. Their purpose is not stated anywhere.

readings.source_reading: √ d.135(4) Do. by Do. ff.1-25. I.O.1783   n.d.: 25:15/17:D.  Two recensions of same work.
readings.evidence: The note is on the same ruled line as d.135(4), after the figures. It is not written as a continuation of the d.122(4) lines.

readings.source_reading: A small ink arrow pointing left ('←') at about (3035–3110, 3625–3650), level with line 1 of d.122(4). On fol. 228, at the same height, there is an ink '———→' pointing right, just below the 'trs. above' brace.
readings.evidence: The two arrows face each other across the gutter at the same height. No written words connect them.
After '21' there is a small raised '1' over a lower figure, which may be '2'. The pencil stroke begins just to its right and overlaps slightly. The stroke extends below the d.135(4) line.
The literal text is only 'Do.' for the title and 'Do.' for the author. Nothing shows whether the title ditto covers the alternative title 'or Rudrānuṣṭhānapaddhati'.

readings.source_reading: There is no shelfmark and no tick before 'Rudrajāpya'.
readings.evidence: The left column at about y 2790–2870 is blank.
'in' is followed by a small roman 'viii' and then 'adhy' with a dot and comma. The letter forms are cursive.

There is a dot under 's' in 'Rudrānuṣ', but no clear dot under 'th'. 'Nārāyana' shows no underdot on 'n'. In line 1, 'Bhatta' shows no clear underdots. In line 2, 'Bhaṭṭa' has dots under 'tt'. In 'Kālevaḍe' there is a dot below the letter read as 'ḍ', and that letter form is doubtful.
